tools.name: sirfus_request_pro
tools.description: Ask Sirfus to find one verified local pro for a person. Free for the person. Needs what they need done, their city and state, and a phone or email they consent to be contacted at. Returns a request id. Use this when someone says things like "find me a plumber in Tampa".

tools.name: sirfus_search
tools.description: Find local vendors for what a person needs, fast: listed Sirfus vendors first, then businesses found on the web. Returns names and badges; a listed vendor's contact is never returned (use sirfus_request_pro so one vendor contacts the person). Any business type: trades, professionals, creatives, shop

tools.name: sirfus_trades
tools.description: Every category Sirfus covers (114 in 15 groups), with what each includes.
